# Ablaze Youth Choir

> Ablaze Youth Choir (also "Ablaze YC" or simply "Ablaze") is a spirit-led youth worship movement out of United Christian Faith Ministries in Baton Rouge, Louisiana — and the 2026 Stellar Gospel Music Awards New Artist of the Year. It blends gospel, urban influence, and contemporary worship, led by director Mark Ellis Jr. ("Marky Mark"). The choir streams on every major platform, sells official merch, and is available to book nationally.

## Key facts
- Name: Ablaze Youth Choir (Ablaze YC / Ablaze)
- Based in: Baton Rouge, Louisiana, USA
- Parent ministry: United Christian Faith Ministries (https://ucfministries.org)
- Director: Mark Ellis Jr., aka Marky Mark (@yofavchurchboy)
- Genre: Gospel, youth worship, contemporary Christian
- Awards: Stellar Gospel Music Awards 2026 — New Artist of the Year (WINNER, announced Aug 15, 2026 at the 41st Stellar Awards, Charlotte NC); Stellar 2026 Contemporary Choir of the Year (nominee); Black Christian Influencers 2025 — Gen Z Influencer of the Year (winner)
- Debut album: "Ablaze" (out now, ~12 tracks)
- Latest single: "Only One" (released Nov 6, 2026)
- Previous single: "No Weapon" (out now)
- Booking: from $5,000 (local) to $25,000+ (national fly-out)
- Contact: worship@ucfministries.org
